;Business and economics
*[[United Kingdom|British]]-[[United States|American]] cruise operator [[Carnival Corporation & PLC]] is fined $20 million for environmental violations. [https://www.npr.org/2019/06/04/729622653/carnival-cruise-lines-hit-with-20-million-penalty-for-environmental-crimes (NPR)]

;International relations
*[[Cuba–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] announces new restrictions on American travel to [[Cuba]]. Effective Wednesday, travel via cruise ships or other conveyances, including private yachts or airplanes, is prohibited. Group travel under the previous "people-to-people educational" provision is also not allowed. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-48503821 (BBC News)] [https://www.wkyt.com/content/news/Trump-administration-imposes-new-restrictions-on-US-travel-to-Cuba-510806781.html (AP via WKYT-TV)]
*[[China–United States relations]], [[China–United States trade war]]
**China expands its [[Travel warning|warnings about travel]] to the U.S. issued for students and academics yesterday, to now cover tourists and businesses because, "in recent days, there have been incidents of gun violence, robberies and thefts in the United States". [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-48522488 (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trade-china/china-warns-its-companies-on-us-travel-rebuffs-trade-criticism-idUSKCN1T50ZK (Reuters)] 
**The United States rejects  separate requests from [[General Motors]] and Chinese-owned [[Volvo Cars]] for an exemption to the new 25 percent tariffs on their Chinese-made [[sport utility vehicle]] models. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trade-china-gm/u-s-denies-gm-request-for-tariff-relief-for-chinese-made-buick-suv-idUSKCN1T530U?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Foreign relations of Brazil]]
**[[Brazil]]'s [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Brazil)|Ministry of Foreign Affairs]] confirms the closure of five of its embassies, the ones in [[Antigua and Barbuda]], [[Saint Vincent and the Grenadines|St. Vincent and the Grenadines]], [[Grenada]], [[Saint Kitts and Nevis|St. Kitts and Nevis]] and [[Dominica]]. Former president [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] had opened more than 65 embassies in countries throughout the [[Global South]] in a bid to enhance political and economic ties with Brazil. [https://www.telesurenglish.net/news/Brazil-Closes-5-Caribbean-Embassies-Citing-Costs-and-Staffing-20190605-0023.html (teleSUR)]
*Nigerian diplomat [[Tijjani Muhammad-Bande]] is elected [[President of the United Nations General Assembly|President]] of the [[United Nations General Assembly]], assuming the office on September and succeeding Peruvian [[María Fernanda Espinosa]]. [https://news.un.org/en/story/2019/06/1039801 (''UN News'')]

;Law and crime
*[[2019 Darwin shooting]]
**A [[mass shooting]] in [[Darwin, Northern Territory|Darwin]], the capital of Australia's [[Northern Territory]], leaves four people dead and another injured at five different locations. The 45-year-old suspect, who had been on parole since January, is arrested. Authorities say the shooting was not terrorism-related. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2019-06-04/northern-territory-police-arrest-gunman-in-darwin-woman-injured/11179136 (ABC News)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-48510881 (BBC News)]
*[[Criminal charges brought in the Mueller special counsel investigation]]
**[[Paul Manafort]], former chief of President [[Donald Trump]]'s [[Donald Trump 2016 presidential campaign|2016 campaign]], is set to be sent from federal prison to the [[New York City]] jail on [[Rikers Island#Complex and facilities|Rikers Island]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/06/04/paul-manafort-to-be-sent-to-new-yorks-rikers-island-jail.html (CNBC)]
*Aftermath of the [[Stoneman Douglas High School shooting]]
**Former [[Broward County Sheriff's Office|Broward Sheriff Office]] deputy Scot Peterson is arrested for failing to act during the [[Stoneman Douglas High School shooting|incident]] at [[Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School]]. [https://thehill.com/blogs/blog-briefing-room/news/446927-deputy-who-stayed-outside-during-parkland-shooting-arrested-and (The Hill)]
*[[States of Jersey Police|Jersey authorities]] seize over $267 million (£210m) from a Doraville Properties Corporation bank account of former Nigerian president and army chief of staff dictator [[Sani Abacha]] (d. 1998) after courts ruled billions of dollars were stolen and laundered through the United States into the [[Channel Islands]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-jersey-48509274 (BBC News)]  [https://metro.co.uk/2019/06/04/nigerian-dictator-211000000-seized-bank-account-channel-islands-9797935/ (''Metro'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Gun laws in Virginia]]
**[[Governor of Virginia|Virginia Governor]] [[Ralph Northam]] is expected to call a special session on gun control following the [[2019 Virginia Beach shooting|deadly shooting]] Friday afternoon in Virginia Beach that killed 12 people plus the shooter. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/following-virginia-beach-massacre-gov-ralph-northam-call-special-session-n1013596 (NBC News)]
*[[30th anniversary of the 1989 Tiananmen Square protests]]
**Tens of thousands of people gather in [[Hong Kong]] to mark the 30th anniversary of the [[Tiananmen Square massacre|crackdown]] on protests in [[Beijing]]'s Tiananmen Square. Hong Kong is one of the two places in China where people can openly commemorate the event, the other being [[Macau]], to a lesser extent; elsewhere in China, the authorities have banned and blocked any reference to the crackdown. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-48516455 (BBC News)]
*Six [[Change UK]] MPs quit the party, with several said to be defecting to the [[Liberal Democrats (UK)|Liberal Democrats]], including its interim leader [[Heidi Allen]] and spokesperson [[Chuka Umunna]] after the party failed to win a single seat in the [[2019 European Parliament election in the United Kingdom|2019 European Parliament election]]. [[Anna Soubry]], one of its remaining four MPs, becomes the party's new leader. [https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2019/jun/04/change-uk-poised-to-lose-at-least-half-its-mps-heidi-allen-chuka-umunna-lib-dems (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Immigration to the United States]]
**The [[United States House of Representatives]] passes the American Dream and Promise Act (HR 6), which offers a path to citizenship for millions of immigrants. [https://www.newsweek.com/what-american-dream-promise-act-bill-promising-path-citizenship-millions-immigrants-expected-1442001 (''Newsweek'')]
